resources.string: Start with Termux and Android permissions, then configure the connections you need. You control installation and service tests.

Start with Termux. Once command access is enabled, ForgeMind installs the helper and missing Python/tmux tools, without restarting existing servers. Internet may be needed. Android permissions still require system confirmation; provider credentials are entered by you.
Termux cannot grant special Android permissions by itself. Request microphone and notifications here, then use Configure on the remaining cards. Already enabled permissions can be skipped.
Preparation installs the helper and missing Python/tmux. It does not start SSH or change passwords. Existing-package upgrades require manual review.
tmux and OpenSSH are available. Continue with permissions and connection settings below. This check does not verify an SSH login.
The previous attempt has no confirmed result here. Check Termux before retrying; it may still be installing packages.
Preparation could not be confirmed. Check command permission, allow-external-apps and the Termux package manager.
Continue setup or review all connections and permissions
Set up models, tools and optional services in one place. You can skip any step and return from Settings. Existing settings stay in place. If you have a backup, restore it before continuing.
Choose a provider and model, enter credentials if needed, then use the connection test. Local models and custom providers are supported.
Choose a working folder and configure local Termux or remote SSH. Termux is optional for chat. Use a separate session for ForgeMind; leave existing server sessions running.
Enable only the features you want. Android grants these permissions on its own screens. A denied permission does not prevent finishing the guide.
Connect external MCP tools and, if needed, enable the ForgeMind MCP server for other clients. Test each connection after saving it.
Choose speech recognition and playback. Configure remote voice services only if you use them; microphone permission is managed in the Permissions step.
Set web search, instructions, memory and tool approvals. The local semantic search model is optional and is downloaded only when you request it.
Choose the app language, theme and text appearance. Language changes preserve your current guide step.
Review the saved configuration. Optional services can remain disabled. Finishing closes the guide without changing your settings or restarting services.
Apply changes with the Save buttons in the forms. Next moves to the following step; it does not save unfinished edits.
This settings screen is unavailable. Open the app page in Android Settings.
Accessibility lets the agent read and operate other apps when you ask it to.
Needed for voice messages. Granting access here does not start a recording.
Show background task progress and service notifications.
Display the chat over another app.
Battery restrictions can interrupt long tasks. Review ForgeMind in the system list; Termux has its own battery settings.
Optional broad access to shared storage. You can instead choose a single working folder in Environments.
Termux is installed. Open it once and let its initial environment setup finish.
Install Termux if you want a Linux terminal on this device, then return to the guide.
Android allows ForgeMind to request Termux commands. The Termux setting below must also be enabled.
Allow ForgeMind to run commands in the Termux environment.
Inside Termux, allow-external-apps must be true in ~/.termux/termux.properties. The copied command appends this setting. Run it in a new shell, not in your server session.
A selected model is not a successful generation test. MCP counts reflect the last recorded connection, not a new test. Use each service’s Test button to verify it now.
